query: Borrowed Speed {level(beastcraft) == 0: Beastcraft I's first spell is taught at a run. Professor Brask points at a hare in the paddock. "Catch it. You won't, on your legs." She teaches you Haste in four words and lets the hare go.|{level(beastcraft) == 1: Beastcraft II: Haste in the air. Brask has a hawk on her glove and a broom against the fence. "Keep up with her," she says, "to the far tower and back."|Advanced Beastcraft: Brask's test is to keep pace with a hippogriff at full gallop, the length of the flight field, and still be able to talk at the end.}} Run it down {level(beastcraft) == 0: You catch the hare on the fourth go, briefly, and it bites you. You sleep eleven hours. Brask says that's the price, and the hare agrees.|{level(beastcraft) == 1: You reach the far tower a wingbeat behind the hawk, and the hawk looks smug about it. Your legs shake all through supper.|You run the field at the hippogriff's shoulder and say "good afternoon" at the end, gasping. Brask laughs once. You're stiff for three days.}} Watch how the hare moves {level(beastcraft) == 0: You watch the hare for an hour, then borrow its speed properly, once, at the end. Everyone else is already muddy and proud of it.|{level(beastcraft) == 1: You watch the hawk's turns from the fence and only fly the course at dusk, alone. It's tidy. Nobody sees.|You study the gallop from the rail until you can feel it in your knees. You run it last, slower than the rest, and very sure.}}

results.excerpt:
Race the Hippogriff
Professor Brask teaches Haste on the flight field, with a stopwatch and a hippogriff that is faster than the spell. "Beat her," she says to you. To the hippogriff she explains, at length and politely, that she is not to bite you if you win.
